method.color_space: CIE Lab, sRGB transfer, D65 white, Euclidean DeltaE76
method.algorithm: 40-cluster weighted Lloyd k-means; snap final centers to nearest existing opaque RGB
method.frequency_weighting: Every alpha=255 pixel has weight one across both images; no image normalization or subsampling
method.initialization: Most frequent RGB first; maximize pixel_count * squared nearest-center Lab distance thereafter
method.tie_break: RGB lexicographic order; cluster index for equal center distances
method.selection: Reserve semantic and people entries first; clusters descending population; reject DeltaE <4; cap 48
method.trial_skins: D2: source #D8A884 plus authored darker warm-earth tones #B9815F #915C40 #68402E; not claimed as source pixels
method.blueprint: Reuse legacy household tunic #6FB0E8; no extra palette slot
